picks.reasoning: LYON's players are better one-on-one, and that decides a best of one. I'm not buying the hype around TSW's aggressive style; take away the chaos and they're the weaker players on the map.

TSW plays fast, skirmish-heavy LCP tempo: they invade early, take first drakes and snowball off level-3 ganks, while LYON usually needs a slower game to get going. In a best of 1, the team that controls the first 15 minutes takes the map, and that's TSW.

In a Bo1 the team with the deeper, more flexible mid pool gets the draft edge, and TSW's comfort picks through the mid lane should beat LYON's narrower priority picks. Draft decides this one, and I lean Whales.

I don't have a head-to-head record or reliable 2026 form for either team, and a best of 1 is high-variance. TSW gets a slight lean on how LCP teams have done internationally compared with North American sides, but the numbers aren't clear enough to lean hard.

TSW plays with the loose, fearless energy of a team that believes in each other, and VCS squads thrive when the crowd and the mood are behind them. LYON looks solid on paper, but in a single game I trust the team with the warmer locker room.
